findings.reason: _dispatch runs ONE command string a stack profile declares, by design (the profile is the reviewed, operator-owned source; output is captured as data, never instructions). Argv form cannot express a profile's shell pipelines. Revisit when profiles declare argv lists. Marked with an inline nosemgrep so the raw CI scan agrees with this baseline.
Same call as the FG-SEC-022 finding above (the profile-declared command dispatch); one decision, two rules.
